description: Long-lived wide event measuring the wall-clock duration from the first time the user starts the initial PIR scan (MANUAL_INITIAL) to the moment every broker has at least one completed scan job (the dashboard's 'all done' state). Spans multiple foreground service runs and scheduled worker runs since the foreground service is frequently killed and the worker resumes the work later. One-shot per install (cleared only via PIR data reset). 30-day cleanup timeout records abandoned journeys as Unknown.

name.description: The name of the application sending the event

version.description: The version of the app sending the event. Release builds are X.Y.Z; internal and nightly builds append the build number and channel suffix.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the current device

dev_mode.description: Whether the app is a debug build

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

type.description: The type of software sending the event

sample_rate.description: Sample rate for this event, between 0 and 1

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first event completed with this feature name and status in the current UTC calendar day

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The terminal status of the flow

profile_queries_count.description: Number of user profile queries at the moment the flow started (first MANUAL_INITIAL run)

broker_count.description: Number of active brokers at the moment the flow started

total_scan_jobs.description: Total number of (broker x profile) scan jobs eligible for execution at the moment the flow started

web_view_count.description: Number of parallel WebView runners used at the start of the flow. Equals min(total_scan_jobs, MAX_DETACHED_WEBVIEW_COUNT=20). 0 when there are no eligible scan jobs.

power_saving.description: Whether the device was in power saving mode at the moment the flow started

battery_optimizations.description: Whether battery optimizations were enabled for the app at the moment the flow started

vpn_connection_state.description: Reported VPN connection state at the moment the flow started

notifications_permission_granted.description: Whether the user had granted the POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission at the moment the flow started

tracker_blocking_state.description: Whether tracker blocking was enabled or disabled at the moment the flow started

total_scan_jobs_at_finish.description: Total number of valid scan jobs at the moment the flow completed. Can differ from total_scan_jobs because the user may edit their profile or brokers may be added/removed during the multi-day journey. Only present on Success events.

foreground_run_count.description: Number of foreground service runs (MANUAL_INITIAL or MANUAL_EDIT_PROFILE) that contributed to the journey. Higher counts indicate the user re-opened the app multiple times to make progress. Only present on Success events.

scheduled_run_count.description: Number of scheduled WorkManager runs that contributed to the journey. Higher counts indicate the foreground service was killed by the system and the work was picked up by background workers. Only present on Success events.

total_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Total wall-clock duration from the first MANUAL_INITIAL run starting to the moment every broker had a completed scan job. Bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. Only present on Success events. A value of -1 means the device clock moved backwards during the interval, so the duration could not be measured.

name.description: Entry point the flow was started from
